name: Puddingkuchen   Custard Bake
instructions: In a bowl combine eggs , sugar , flour and milk
Grease a stoneware dish with all the butter
Pour in the dough and add fruit , raisins or almonds to taste
Bake in the cold oven at 180c for about 60 minutes or until custard has set
You might need to cover the dish after 40 minutes or so
Allow to stand and set for at least 10 minutes before serving
